tolerance.note: default for point values; ranges are inclusive; the approximate values carry two digits and the tutorial says they depend on the NRTL parameters

scenarios.why: 350 K, 5 K below the tutorial's stated bubble point of about 355 K: everything should stay liquid, so the vapour stream is empty (the tutorial says nothing about this case; the expectation follows from its bubble and dew statements)
370 K, 5 K above the tutorial's stated dew point of about 365 K: everything should be vapour, so the liquid stream is empty

review.method: ranges and approximate values transcribed from the tutorial; mass balance exact; the below-bubble and above-dew scenarios follow from the tutorial's bubble (~355 K) and dew (~365 K) statements
